purpose: 第三阶段经典方法排查；只做诊断，不开发新方法

inputs.features: DINOv2 ViT-B/14 768-D frozen CLS, L2 normalized
inputs.subset: identical to stage one: int((50000/K)*(1/IR)**(c/(K-1))), RandomState(seed), per-class prefix
inputs.pca: PCA(n_components=128, random_state=seed) fitted on current subset

vMF_free.status: spherical mixture EM, free weights/concentration, KMeans init, max_iter=100

OVER_ORACLE_MERGE.mapping: microcluster majority true class; supervised diagnostic only

evaluation.tail: 30 smallest true classes with class-id tie break
evaluation.statistics: mean/std population ddof=0; paired same dataset/IR/seed

decision.rule2: best B-group BA gap >=0.30 in >=4/5 and >=half methods predicted K mean<=80 or tail coverage<=0.10 at IR100, absent at IR1
decision.rule3: descriptive OVER_ORACLE_MERGE K'=200/300/500 and gap to OVER_MERGE
decision.best_classic: per-seed maximum across A methods; optimistic diagnostic envelope
